findings.title: SQL Injection in GET /vulnerabilities/sqli/?id= -> Full Table Read + Credential Extraction
findings.evidence: Baseline request id=1 returned exactly one row (ID: 1, First name: admin, Surname: admin). Payload id=1' OR '1'='1 returned all 5 rows in the users table (admin, Gordon Brown, Hack Me, Pablo Picasso, Bob Smith) -- boolean-based injection confirmed by row-count change. Follow-up payload id=1' UNION SELECT user, password FROM users-- - returned all 5 rows with the 'Surname' field replaced by real MD5 password hashes (e.g. 5f4dcc3b5aa765d61d8327deb882cf99, which is MD5('password')) -- UNION-based injection confirmed, full credential exfiltration achieved.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries/prepared statements for the id parameter instead of string concatenation. Apply least-privilege DB accounts. Never store passwords as unsalted MD5; use a modern salted KDF (bcrypt/argon2).

findings.title: Reflected XSS in GET /vulnerabilities/xss_r/?name=
findings.evidence: Request with name=<script>alert('xss')</script> returned the payload reflected verbatim and unescaped in the response body (confirmed via raw grep match on the exact <script> tag in the returned HTML) -- executes in the victim's browser in the context of the DVWA origin.
findings.remediation: HTML-encode all user-supplied input before reflecting it into page output (e.g. htmlspecialchars() in PHP). Add a Content-Security-Policy header as defense-in-depth.

findings.title: OS Command Injection in POST /vulnerabilities/exec/ (ip parameter)
findings.evidence: Request with ip=127.0.0.1 && id returned the expected ping output followed by uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data) in the response body -- confirms the injected `id` shell command executed on the server, in addition to the intended ping command.
findings.remediation: Never pass user input to a shell (shell_exec/exec/system) even after validation. Use a language-native ICMP/ping library, or strictly allow-list the input as a validated IPv4/IPv6 address with no shell metacharacters, and use escapeshellarg()/parameterized subprocess calls if shelling out is unavoidable.
